follows: reports/c59_matcher_verdict_partition.json, which localised 93% of the residue to roll_component_events_agree
method: instrumented the three False-returns of roll_component_events_agree and scoped the counters PER ROW, cleared before each boundary, restricted to the 341 unattributed rows. My first pass counted branch-comparisons across every row including attributed ones -- 71/18/11 -- which conflates a row having many branches with a row being hard. Corrected before reporting this time rather than after.
the_finding: 203 of 341 rows -- 60% -- are rejected by ONE line: `if len(observed) != len(engine): return False`, and by nothing else. No magnitude disagreed, no roll fell outside its legal set, no attribution conflicted. The engine simply produced a different NUMBER of HP components than the simulator on every branch. Another 120 rows hit that line plus something else, so the count check fires on 323 of 341.
why_that_matters: A length check is the crudest possible comparison and it is the dominant rejector. It cannot distinguish 'the engine modelled a different outcome' from 'the engine rendered the same outcome with a different number of events' -- which is exactly the defect class C55 fixed, where an unrendered Sleep Talk callee damage line made the counts differ. C55 cleared 331 rows through this same line.
what_this_does_NOT_license: relaxing the length check. Protocol order and component count are load-bearing: the function's own docstring says a branch that moves HP events is a different branch rather than interchangeable evidence. Making the comparison length-tolerant would admit false matches wholesale. The lead is not 'loosen the check', it is 'find the remaining places where the engine's event stream under- or over-describes an outcome it modelled correctly'.
next: for the 203 count-mismatch-only rows, tabulate observed-count versus engine-count and the sources present on each side. C55 was found exactly this way, by reading the two lists rather than aggregating over them.
does_not_reach_a_pass: no code changed; unattributed stays at 341
